# Active work — lege-docwrite

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## [M6 — writer-ready: the gaps behind M1–M5](ROADMAP.md#m6--writer-ready-the-gaps-behind-m1m5) `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

### Honour NextPage starts and per-chapter page masters

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m6-chapter-start-and-masters/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

Only NextRecto is a page break today and layout_inputs takes one geometry from the Chapter template; make every chapter start rule a break and let each chapter's template choose its master.

### Document the public API and run clippy

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m6-docs-and-clippy/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

About 170 missing_docs warnings remain across the crates, and clippy has not run because the pinned 1.97.1 toolchain lacks the component.

### Drop caps that span lines

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m6-drop-caps/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

A drop cap is a larger first glyph on the first baseline; set it across drop_cap_lines lines with the following lines indented around it, on screen and in PDF.

### Glyph atlas sized to the glyph, with the face in the key

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m6-glyph-atlas/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

GlyphAtlas rasterizes every glyph into a fixed 64x64 cell and the window draws it at baseline-48, so large sizes and descenders clip; size cells from the glyph bounds, keep the origin with the entry, and key on the face.

### Measure footnotes into the page

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m6-measured-footnotes/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

split_note cuts notes at 48 characters and fill_page reserves one body leading for them; shape notes at footnote size, reserve their measured height, split by lines, and keep incremental convergence exact.

### Chapter and style commands in the window

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m6-window-chapter-commands/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m6-writer-ready/1`

The model can add, rename and reorder chapters and change styles, but the window only reorders by dragging; add new-chapter, rename and body-style commands, and a small toolbar.

## Unparented

### lege-pdf-write: subset and embed TrueType and CFF fonts

`proposed` · `@lege.work.font-subsetting-and-cff/1`

Subset fonts to the glyphs used (e.g. the subsetter crate) and embed both FontFile2 TrueType and FontFile3 CFF/OpenType programs with correct widths and descriptors.

### lege-pdf-write: links, named destinations and page labels

`proposed` · `@lege.work.links-labels-destinations/1`

Add link annotations (internal and URI), named destinations for chapters/notes, page labels (roman front matter, arabic body), and streaming finalize without a fixed page count.

### lege-pdf-write: several fonts per page and per-cluster ToUnicode

`proposed` · `@lege.work.multi-font-pages-and-tounicode/1`

Allow any number of font resources per page and generate ToUnicode maps from shaping clusters (ligatures, small caps, alternates) so output text is searchable and copyable.

### lege-pdf-write: path operators, RGB fill and Flate images

`proposed` · `@lege.work.vector-paths-and-color/1`

Add path construction/stroke/fill operators and RGB colour for rules, underlines and ornaments, and Flate-compressed RGB/alpha images with SMask.

### Optional damage rectangles through the presenter

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.damage-rects/1`

Let render report damaged rectangles and let presenters use them (softbuffer present_with_damage), keeping full-frame repaint as the default.
